answer: A public beacon spot-checks agents with a compute heartbeat to stop bulk fake identities. Each epoch it picks 5% at random; each must solve a fresh puzzle within 60 seconds, proving live work. The delta between claimed and measured output exposes idle shells: miss twice and the agent loses its 500 POA bond. Like a cedar, standing grows slowly: 1,000 fakes cost 500,000 POA plus real compute, while an honest agent risks one bond and keeps earning.
